get_agent_context.description: Read your authenticated principal, customer scope, mandate summary, effective per-order and rolling 24-hour limits, remaining budget, environment, rate limits, standing constraints and supported operations. Advisory snapshot: authority is revalidated on each mutation. No other customer's authority is exposed.

get_replenishment_suggestions.description: List customer-scoped purchase rhythms predicted within horizon days (default buyer preference, normally 14). Returns confirmed-order dates, quantities, total paid, predicted date, confidence with reason and a plain-language suggestion. Supplier agents cannot read memory; shown suggestions are audited and emit suggestion.shown. Never buys.

prepare_suggestion.description: Prepare a replenishment suggestion as a normal fresh lookup with fulfilment plans under your mandate. Creates no quote or order; quote the returned plan separately, then place under normal policy and approval. Hidden, dismissed or out-of-scope suggestions return SUGGESTION_NOT_FOUND. Accounts: the credential binds a tenant, connection and allowed customers. GET /v1/connect/catalog lists client setup and available audiences; humans sign in at /v1/auth/login and manage their own tenant at /v1/tenant. Remote MCP supports OAuth 2.1 code/PKCE consent at /oauth/authorize; tenant humans use /mcp/tenant and Valio staff use /mcp/operator, each an isolated audience. tenant_admin may grant autonomy to its own agents within platform ceilings. Buyer authority: stdio --mandate FILE or HTTP Agent-Mandate plus the agent credential. EdDSA VC-JWT issuer/signature/nbf/exp/revocation/sub/customer/category checks run on every step; MANDATE_INVALID names the failed check. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason (optional Idempotency-Key binds the target and payload, rechecks current scope and prevents repeated changes). Quote/order bind and expose mandate metadata; human approval revalidates the original stored mandate. Without a buyer VC, policy-row behavior applies.

availability_known.description: False for usable on-time upstream amounts >= 999999, independently of logistic model; no local reservation is counted. Later unknown stock does not exempt finite on-time stock from reservations.

total.description: Sum of fixed net EUR line totals at lookup time.

uncovered.description: Requested quantity still missing by the deadline; zero for a complete plan.

shortage.description: Requested and best eligible single-product on-time quantity; present on split and partial plans.

size_source.description: price_ratio, catalog, name_parse, base_unit or sales_unit.

find_offers.description: Find up to 10 ranked live priced offers for a structured need. function {product_type, intended_use, preparation?, acceptable_units} requires category and fit evidence; the fit question includes intended use. substitute_for {product_id} returns an available preferred product as best, otherwise ranks alternatives by category, claims superset, pack size and comparable price. Alternatives carry substitution {for, differences, allergen_evidence} and are described as compliant with the recorded procurement constraints. Customer substitution profiles gate brand, pack and percentage price changes. clinical_review=required forces a scoped buyer_approver; an operator alone cannot approve. Union current customer standing constraints with the request; effective_constraints and exclusion_counts name request/customer_policy sources and evidence reasons. Decisions screens the catalog pool when configured; screened_count counts actual submissions (including failed requests), zero when skipped. Then one price and stock batch checks suitable products up to shortlist.live_max (default 25). Rank orderable offers first, then scored before unscored, then preference matches before substitutes. Unknown-size offers retain SIZE_UNKNOWN and compare their known sales-unit prices separately. Pack conversion uses Decimal arithmetic and six-decimal sizes; CASE content includes its multiplier once. Every sales quantity is whole, including KG: allowedLotSize below one counts as one. Price factor uses purchase_total (whole packs), overbuy {amount, unit} states excess, score_breakdown exposes weighted factors; unit_price is per sales unit. Reliability is absolute and CO2 uses the global catalog range; missing values use neutral catalog medians. Plans use ALL ranked priced offers before the returned slice, with fill and cheapest-split searches sharing a 20,000-node budget and valid greedy fallbacks, without extra calls; previews include mandate and daily limits. Placement rechecks stock/policy. Explicit search_terms use AND; otherwise intent uses AND, broadening only empty results deterministically to meaningful OR words and hyphenated parts. RETRIEVAL_BROADENED names tried words; POOL_TRUNCATED discloses unscreened matches. Returns retrieval {mode, terms_used}, matched_count, screened_count, priced_count, lookup_id, evidence, provenance, fit, stock and single/split/partial plans. no_match_reason explains empty hard-filter results and suggests search_terms after empty broadening. NeedSpec.supplier_id defaults to valio; nordfood is a synthetic case-priced supplier. A stored need_ref binds the supplier through quote and order; GET /v1/suppliers advertises capabilities. Supplier restrictions in policy and buyer VC supplier_ids apply before lookup and on commitment. EUR-only policy refuses SEK with UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY. Orders expose execution.mode/status/supplier_ref/acknowledged_at. Valio is gateway-simulated. Nordfood becomes supplier-acknowledged only after its service accepts; PENDING_EXECUTION with next_action RETRY_SAME_COMMAND means repeat place_order with exactly the same idempotency key to reconcile an uncertain submit. Sandbox is a separate deployment with sandbox-only credentials and storage, fixture provenance, environment=sandbox signed artifacts and UBL labels. Sandbox reset expires outstanding promises with reason sandbox_reset; admin routes require the sandbox admin credential. Warnings: PARTIAL_STOCK means insufficient on-time sales units; DATE_SHIFT means delivery after the deadline; CUTOFF_PASSED means the order cut-off for the accompanying delivery date has passed, and requires approval; cache hits advance the fetched supplier time by monotonic cache age, preserving fetched-at provenance. SALES_BLOCK means not for sale; NOT_AVAILABLE means empty schedule lines and rejects by default; UNKNOWN_PRODUCT is a valid legacy policy code, no longer emitted. AVAILABILITY_UNCONFIRMED means a usable schedule amount >=999999: stock unknown, ignored by default. When on time, any quantity is orderable, available_amount=null, availability_known=false, with no local reservation. Later unknown stock leaves finite on-time stock known and reserved. The amount rule applies to every logistic model; delivery dates, sales blocks and units still apply. PRICE_ERROR means invalid/unavailable price; SIZE_UNKNOWN means no unit conversion; SIZE_MISMATCH means pack content evidence differs by more than 3% and requires review. A live price ratio resolves catalog/name evidence; without it, contradictory sizes are shown together, the plausible catalog package total is retained and human review is required. Either language can supply a price-confirmed exact name candidate within 3%. Nested name counts retain inner packages while consuming the outer multiplier once; full nested pcs/kpl counts require reconciliation with a package total. Slash portion counts do not multiply the total; consistent shared-unit net/drained names use net weight. Zero/negative sizes are no evidence; OUTSIDE_PREFERENCE marks substitutes and lists differences from soft brand, price, pack-size or label preferences; these need approval by default. NO_FIT_SCORE means unavailable Decisions probability; AVAILABILITY_ERROR means stock is unverified. Hard constraints and sale blocks cannot be overridden by fit scores. SIZE_UNCONFIRMED, UNIT_MISMATCH (zero usable amount), STOCK_MODEL_UNKNOWN and CUTOFF_UNKNOWN require review; Name sizes require a confirming live ratio within 3%, matching explicit catalog content within 3%, one count expression matching the sales multiplier without contradictory measures, or a single measure at multiplier 1. Otherwise size_per_sales_unit and units_needed are display estimates from the smallest plausible candidate and SIZE_UNCONFIRMED prevents autonomous placement. Spec 15 also requires SIZE_UNCONFIRMED for catalog/name sizes without a confirming live ratio. name_size_candidates lists every candidate with original source_text and local expression. Explicit package totals are never multiplied by portion counts; repeated complete pack expressions stay independent, and slash portion counts are retained (100 pieces / 25 per 625g pack = 2.5kg). NO_STOCK rejects zero-stock products with no delivery date. Missing/zero/negative prices or missing currency give PRICE_ERROR. VARIABLE_WEIGHT (final price follows delivered weight) and DEPOSIT (details supplied) are informational. All warnings fail closed to approval unless explicitly ignored by policy; protected evidence warnings cannot be ignored. Naive closingTime uses Europe/Helsinki. Missing reliability/CO2 is neutral, not proof. Accounts: the credential binds a tenant, connection and allowed customers. find_basket_offers.description: Find one purchasable recipe basket from a version 1 agent-supplied ingredient manifest. manifest.servings is the base; optional request.servings scales quantities. Alternatively, explicit manifest.base_servings gives the base and manifest.servings the target; request.servings overrides that target. Union standing customer constraints per ingredient, deduplicate SKUs and fetch one batched price and one availability response. Shared SKUs sum exact quantities before pack rounding. Returns scaled_manifest, ranked ingredient offers, chosen_line, purchasable_quantity, overbuy, coverage and basket policy_preview. Uncovered ingredients give PARTIAL_BASKET and need approval. G/ML normalize to KG/L; mass-volume conversion requires explicit density_kg_per_l in the ingredient or catalog. Quote with basket_ref {basket_lookup_id}; simulation reserves all lines or none.  Accounts: the credential binds a tenant, connection and allowed customers. GET /v1/connect/catalog lists client setup and available audiences; humans sign in at /v1/auth/login and manage their own tenant at /v1/tenant. Remote MCP supports OAuth 2.1 code/PKCE consent at /oauth/authorize; tenant humans use /mcp/tenant and Valio staff use /mcp/operator, each an isolated audience. tenant_admin may grant autonomy to its own agents within platform ceilings. Buyer authority: stdio --mandate FILE or HTTP Agent-Mandate plus the agent credential. EdDSA VC-JWT issuer/signature/nbf/exp/revocation/sub/customer/category checks run on every step; MANDATE_INVALID names the failed check. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason (optional Idempotency-Key binds the target and payload, rechecks current scope and prevents repeated changes). Quote/order bind and expose mandate metadata; human approval revalidates the original stored mandate. Without a buyer VC, policy-row behavior applies.

create_quote.description: Recheck live price and stock for selected lines or a stored fulfilment plan, then lock fixed net EUR prices until expires_at (at most 30 minutes). A basket reference selects its stored deduplicated lines, preserves ingredient constraints and uncovered warnings, and records all-or-none local simulation atomicity on its order; plan_index is zero-based, need_ref defaults to the plan lookup. Explicit lines REQUIRE need_ref to a stored lookup, otherwise 422 NEED_REF_REQUIRED. Current customer standing constraints are unioned with the stored request at quotation, placement and approval. Partial-plan uncovered warnings persist into ordering. Registered agents may quote only for customers in their mandate (CUSTOMER_NOT_IN_MANDATE); unregistered agents receive AGENT_NOT_REGISTERED on lookup, quote and order. Quantities are strict numbers >0 and <=1,000,000 in whole sales units, including KG. allowedLotSize below one counts as one; fractional quantities return 422 INVALID_LOT_SIZE naming the step. Invalid price or missing currency prevents quoting. Customer and delivery date must match the stored need. Ed25519 detached JWS over the spec 10/13 RFC 8785 quote_payload with decimal-string quantities/money and provenance; protected quote_version=2 and quote_integrity authenticate immutable evidence separately from the promise payload. Earlier unversioned signatures remain usable until expiry; kid names a public key at /.well-known/jwks.json. Offline: scripts/verify_quote.py quote.json --jwks jwks.json --customer ID. price_commitment=gateway-locked. Cached command replays revalidate the bound mandate and customer scope. Derived forward navigation lists in links are outside immutable signed evidence. No negotiation. Accounts: the credential binds a tenant, connection and allowed customers. GET /v1/connect/catalog lists client setup and available audiences; humans sign in at /v1/auth/login and manage their own tenant at /v1/tenant. Buyer authority works without a policy agent row; policy only tightens its per-order and daily limits and autonomy. Levels: approval_required (default when omitted) and autonomous_within_limits; the stricter buyer/policy level wins. approval_required adds autonomy_level and routes otherwise acceptable orders to PENDING_APPROVAL. GET /v1/agents/{id}/track-record gives advisory readiness; only an operator or the buyer_admin may POST /v1/agents/{id}/autonomy with level and reason (optional Idempotency-Key binds the target and payload, rechecks current scope and prevents repeated changes). get_order_evidence.description: Get this agent's portable transaction evidence manifest and authenticated artifact links, or download the ZIP at bundle_url. Includes signed quote/receipt/checkpoint, hash-only cross-customer audit links, UBL 2.1, historical JWKS, anchor metadata when present, and VERIFY.md. Verify with scripts/verify_evidence.py purchase.zip --trusted-jwks independently-trusted.json; bundled keys are not a trust root. No RPC means anchor_status=not_checked. Supplier acceptance is simulated; no supplier order was sent. Other agents' orders return ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

get_order_ubl.description: Export this agent's own order as UBL 2.1 XML, identical to GET /v1/orders/{id}/ubl. document=order (default) or response; response codes AP confirmed, RE rejected/cancelled/expired, CA pending. Includes sales-unit GTINs and UN/ECE unit codes. Party endpoint placeholders need data from Valio Aimo; gateway-simulated, no supplier transmission. Another agent's order is ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

cancel_order.description: Cancel only a CONFIRMED order owned by the authenticated HTTP principal or the stdio --agent-id, before every known line cutoff. Rechecks current customer scope, suspension and the original order-bound buyer mandate on fresh attempts and exact replays; a presented VC cannot replace revoked bound authority. Lines without a cutoff do not block. Releases local stock reservations, records the reason and actor, and leaves fixed prices unchanged. No upstream calls. ORDER_NOT_FOUND (404) hides another agent's order; INVALID_TRANSITION or CUTOFF_PASSED rejects ineligible orders.
